column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Arrival in Canaan
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: So this is the city $$ユダ$$ spoke of...
$$カナン$$, where a $$領主$$ who bought an $$大邪神$$ armor lives!
Everyone seems to go faithfully to church, follow the Bible's teachings, and lead $$怠惰$$ lives!
Excellent, excellent!!
Rest when you want to rest, eat when you want to eat.
That is the natural order written in our own Bible!
Oh, come on.
Everyone in this town looks like a living corpse—a zombie before it starts to rot!
The old man and $$ルピルピ$$ were originally $$神官$$s of the $$教団$$...
So under the surface, they're birds of a feather with the $$教団$$, huh?!
Hey! That's no way to put it!
Every $$世界$$ needs some sort of order!
Even if it does not entirely suit one's own wishes!
Even you can understand that much, can't you?
Whatever... This city stinks, and I hate it!
Hey, $$カイン$$! Let's hurry to another town~!
I told you, this guy isn't $$カイン$$...
What do you want?!
Do you have any proof that he isn't $$カイン$$?!
If I say he's $$カイン$$, then he's definitely $$カイン$$,
so you all call him $$カイン$$ too!
Right, $$カイン$$~?!
This city is full of people like the old me somehow, so I feel at ease here!
Something smells nice~! I'm getting hungry too!
Yay! Food, food!
$$プリカ$$ wants a hamburger with corn in it...
Hey, meat thief!!
Do you even know what hamburgers are made of?!
Whatever you do, don't steal from the butcher here again!
If I don't warn you, this journey will turn into a hundred-and-one-animal parade...
Hey, you!!
Why are you keeping a $$日記$$ too?!
